searchText: I'm playing around with `master` on Geth, is it correct that it's not yet opening the authrpc port before the transition happens? I'm adding some "merge readiness" logging to LH and if I go ahead and say that Prater users should be getting ready *now* then they're going to start getting logs to configure their EE when that's not possible. Also interested in how other EEs are treating the auth port before the TTD is set. I would say this is incorrect, at least it makes `exchangeTransitionConfiguration` unusable. As for me, there is no reason for auth port to depend on TTD The pr is not merged yet Just waiting for someone to push the button Here are my summarised thoughts on the prater/goerli alias: https://github.com/sigp/lighthouse/issues/3338#issuecomment-1189976253 TL;DR I think that LH is going to go ahead with Goerli being an entirely different (but compatible) network to Prater. This means that existing users who understand the Prater+Goerli union can stay with `--network prater` and know they won't have their directory structure change under their feet now or in the future. New users, on the other hand, can just start using `--network goerli` and never know that Prater was ever a thing. It's also less work 🚀 Once everyone decides what `CONFIG_NAME` should be then we'll just change it for both Goerli and Prater. Sorry I should say the port is not opening until the TTD is specified. My bad. MSF9 is finalizing again: https://beaconchain.mainnetshadowfork9.ethdevops.io/ It had a non-finality period of ~1300 epochs I think. A combination of fixes and migrating a lot of validators to target healthy beacon nodes brought a lot of the network back online. Switching back to finality after such a big non-finality period saw no issues, everything seems to have proceeded as expected. Some client teams are still testing fixes, so the shadow fork will stay around until that's done. As a recap: - Goerli shadow fork will still be happening tomorrow. We will be adding Mev-Boost on friday (post merge) to run some tests on that as well. - Mainnet shadow fork 10 will be happening next week wednesday at ~2PM UTC. Configs found here: https://github.com/eth-clients/merge-testnets/tree/main/mainnet-shadow-fork-10

excerpts.author: paulhauner
excerpts.content:
Here are my summarised thoughts on the prater/goerli alias:

https://github.com/sigp/lighthouse/issues/3338#issuecomment-1189976253

TL;DR I think that LH is going to go ahead with Goerli being an entirely different (but compatible) network to Prater. This means that existing users who understand the Prater+Goerli union can stay with `--network prater` and know they won't have their directory structure change under their feet now or in the future. New users, on the other hand, can just start using `--network goerli` and never know that Prater was ever a thing. It's also less work 🚀

MSF9 is finalizing again: https://beaconchain.mainnetshadowfork9.ethdevops.io/

It had a non-finality period of ~1300 epochs I think. A combination of fixes and migrating a lot of validators to target healthy beacon nodes brought  a lot of the network back online. 

Switching back to finality after such a big non-finality period saw no issues, everything seems to have proceeded as expected. Some client teams are still testing fixes, so the shadow fork will stay around until that's done.
